Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: a production 6-frame full-body animation sprite atlas for an existing illustrated Korean fantasy RPG lobby. The provided image is the exact character identity and outfit reference. Make a clean transparent 1536x1024 landscape sheet arranged precisely THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, six equally sized 512x512 cells, one identical character per cell. No frames, text, numbers, backgrounds, shadows, scenery, extra characters or effects. Keep a generous 35px transparent gutter INSIDE every cell so no limb/weapon/cape crosses a cell boundary. Every frame uses the same camera, proportions, head size, scale, frontal view and planted foot baseline. Character full-body INCLUDING BOTH BOOTS AND COMPLETE WEAPON. Feet centered at cell-local x=256, y=470, head crown at y=40. Match original warm brown crisp linework and cream/coral/navy cel-shaded anime style. All six are the SAME model, not six costume variants. Frames left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 0 relaxed happy idle with open eyes; 1 EXACT same idle, half-closed eyelids only; 2 EXACT same idle, fully closed smiling eyelids only; 3 begin friendly greeting, free hand raised near chest and head barely tilted, eyes open; 4 free hand open waving beside cheek, palm tilted left, eyes open happy; 5 same wave with palm tilted right and bright smile. Wave hand stays BELOW crown, weapon stays in other hand safely down to the side in all frames. Preserve all original costume details and identity. Transparent alpha, no checkerboard painted into the image.
Ari is the orange ponytailed girl with the gold star hair clip, cream coat, navy cape and star wand; her ponytail and hair clip must stay identical.
